Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1395
Claimant:
Devon Rogers
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
21 May 2024
First notice of loss received for a low-speed collision in a parking lot involving the insured's vehicle and a second
vehicle. The claimant reports a shoulder injury from the impact and is not represented by an attorney.
26 May 2024
Recorded a recorded statement from the claimant, who described the sequence of events in the same way as the
initial report. The claimant confirmed they were the driver of the vehicle at the time.
1 Aug 2024
Reviewed the poilcy and confirmed the driver is listed as a named insured, and that coverage was in force when the
loss occurred. Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy start.
18 Aug 2024
Obtained photographs of the vehicle damage. The pattern and location of the damage match the impact described by
the claimant and the other driver.
14 Sep 2024
Spoke with the other driver, who confirmed the collision happened as the claimant described it. Witness statements
gathered so far align with both accounts.
16 Sep 2024
Police report reviewed. The responding officer's notes confirm the claimant was seated in the vehicle when the
collision occurred.
22 Sep 2024
Requested prior claim history and vehicle records. No earlier damage to the vehicle is on record, and no previous
claims were located for this vehicle.
3 Oct 2024
Claimant provided treatment records for the shoulder injury. The reported injury fits the type and force of a collision of
this kind.
21 Oct 2024
Medical file shows a course of treatment typical for a soft tissue shuolder injury, with visits tapering as the claimant's
range of motion and pain improved.
21 Nov 2024
Claimant disclosed a minor strain to the same sohulder many years ago, which healed fully with no lasting limitation.
Records from that episode were requested for completeness.
28 Nov 2024
Claimant's account has remained consistent across every contact so far, including the initial report, the recorded
statement, and follow-up calls.
2 Dec 2024
File review complete. The accident, vehicle damage, injury, and treatment all appear consistent with one another, and
the claim is ready for settlement evaluation.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
